en.commentary:
I have been waiting three years for this category to become rankable, and the FDA settled it on September 29, 2025 by confirming that NMN belongs inside the dietary supplement definition after all. That single date makes most of the buying guides still sitting at the top of search results obsolete, and it means you can finally choose between NR and NMN on the merits.

My answer is Tru Niagen 300mg. Niagen nicotinamide riboside chloride is the one NAD+ ingredient with a paper trail you can pull up yourself: NDI notification No. 882, which FDA did not object to, and GRAS notice GRN 000635, which cleared it for food and beverage use at up to 300 mg per serving. Both numbers sit in public FDA inventories tonight, and the 300 mg capsule matches the dose used in the human trials. At $127 for 90 capsules that works out to about $42 a month, which I consider fair for the best documented molecule here.

Thorne NiaCel 400 takes second because Thorne certifies the finished bottle. NSF Certified for Sport means the product in your hand was the thing that got tested, and at $1.23 a capsule for 415 mg of NR plus 85 mg of betaine it delivers the cheapest daily NR dose on this list, around $37 a month.

Third goes to Life Extension NAD+ Cell Regenerator, which puts the identical licensed 300 mg Niagen into a $40.50 bottle and asks nothing else of you.

On the NMN side I trust Renue By Science most, because the batch number stamped on the bottle matches a dated certificate published on their site. That matters more than any marketing claim: the 2024 GeroScience analysis of 18 NMN products measured content ranging from 0% to 104.5% of the label claim, with only 7 landing within 10% of what the bottle said. Buy the ones that show you the paperwork.

highlights.title: The September 2025 FDA reversal made every NMN guide written before it obsolete
highlights.body: FDA pulled NMN out of the dietary supplement definition in 2022 after ruling it had been investigated as a drug first. The Natural Products Association sued in August 2024, and on September 29, 2025 FDA confirmed NMN is not excluded. On December 2, 2025 the agency wrote to SyncoZymes reinstating its acknowledgment of that company's May 2022 NDI notification, and NPA voluntarily dropped the case. If a buying guide still tells you NMN is banned, it stopped updating more than a year ago, and you should treat its product picks with exactly that much confidence.

highlights.title: Niagen wins on paperwork, and paperwork is the only quality signal you can check yourself
highlights.body: ChromaDex filed NDI notification No. 882 for nicotinamide riboside chloride in 2015 and FDA raised no objection. GRAS notice GRN 000635 followed in 2016, clearing up to 300 mg per serving in food and beverage. Both entries are searchable in FDA's public inventories from your phone in under a minute. I grade every product here on three levels: the ingredient appears in an FDA inventory with a number attached, the ingredient is lawful to sell under the 2025 NMN status, or the ingredient appears in neither. Tru Niagen, Life Extension and Pure Encapsulations all sit in the top tier because they license the same Niagen material.

highlights.title: A third of NMN products miss their label claim, so demand a dated certificate with a batch number on it
highlights.body: Sandalova and colleagues tested 18 NMN supplements for GeroScience in 2024 and measured NMN content between 0% and 104.5% of the label claim, with only 7 products landing within 10% of what the bottle said and three containing none at all. This is why Renue By Science leads my NMN picks: the batch code printed on the bottle bottom matches a dated third-party certificate published on their site, so you can verify the specific jar sitting in your cupboard. The brands worth your money attach the document and tie it to the lot in your hand.

highlights.title: Work out your monthly cost at the clinical dose, because serving sizes are doing a lot of work here
highlights.body: The trial doses that mean anything land around 300 mg a day for NR and 500 mg a day for NMN. Normalize to those numbers and the ranking rearranges itself. Thorne comes in near $37 a month, Tru Niagen at about $42 on the 90-count bottle, Life Extension at $40.50, and partiQlar at roughly $32 for the NMN route. Wonderfeel's 900 mg formula runs $73 a month on subscription and $88 one time, which is real money paid for the added ergothioneine, hydroxytyrosol and vitamin D3. Do this arithmetic before you sign up for any subscription.

highlights.title: Pick your molecule on evidence volume, then pick your brand on documentation
highlights.body: NR holds the larger body of published human trials, including the placebo-controlled Elysium study in npj Aging that reported a 40% average NAD+ increase within a month, and that depth is why NR takes my top four slots. NMN is now the cheaper route to a clinical dose with its legal status settled, and partiQlar at roughly $32 a month is the clearest example of that. Choose the route that fits your budget, then spend every bit of remaining scrutiny on whether the brand publishes lot-level results.

zh-tw.commentary:
這個題目我等了三年才等到可以認真排，因為 FDA 在 2025 年 9 月 29 日正式認定 NMN 沒有被排除在膳食補給品的定義之外。講白了，現在網路上還排在前面的那些選購文，大多停在 2023 年「NMN 被禁」的舊結論，資訊已經過期一年多。

我的答案是 Tru Niagen 300mg。Niagen 這個 NR 氯化物是整個品類裡唯一有完整公開文件的成分，NDI 通報第 882 號 FDA 沒有提出異議，GRAS 通知 GRN 000635 的無異議函也放行到每份 300 毫克，這兩組編號你現在拿手機就能在 fda.gov 上查到。300 毫克這個劑量剛好對得上人體試驗實際用的量。90 顆裝 127 美元換算下來一個月約 42 美元，換成台幣差不多一千三，一個月一千三買一個文件最齊全的成分，我覺得很合理。

第二名 Thorne NiaCel 400，它厲害的地方在於認證做在成品上。NSF Certified for Sport 是整瓶送驗，你手上那瓶就是被測的那個東西。一顆 1.23 美元有 415 毫克 NR 加 85 毫克甜菜鹼，一個月約 37 美元，是這份榜單裡每日 NR 成本最低的。

第三名 Life Extension 用的是同一批授權的 300 毫克 Niagen，一瓶 40.5 美元，入手價最低。

NMN 這條路線我最信 Renue By Science，因為瓶底的批號可以直接對到官網上有日期的檢驗報告。這件事說真的很重要，2024 年 GeroScience 那篇研究測了 18 款 NMN，實測含量落在標示值的 0% 到 104.5% 之間，只有 7 款落在正負 10% 以內。願意把文件攤開給你看的，才值得下單。

highlights.title: 2025 年 9 月那一紙認定，讓多數 NMN 選購文一夜過期
highlights.body: 時序其實很清楚。FDA 在 2022 年以「先被列為藥物研究」為由，把 NMN 撤出膳食補給品的定義；NPA 在 2024 年 8 月提告；2025 年 9 月 29 日 FDA 認定 NMN 未被排除；2025 年 12 月 2 日 FDA 致函 SyncoZymes，恢復 2022 年 5 月對其 NDI 通報的承認，NPA 隨後自願撤告。所以你現在看到任何一篇還在寫「NMN 已被禁售」的文章，代表它超過一年沒更新，裡面的產品推薦也請用同樣的信心去看。

highlights.title: Niagen 贏在文件，而文件是你自己查得動的唯一品質指標
highlights.body: ChromaDex 在 2015 年替 NR 氯化物提出 NDI 通報第 882 號，FDA 沒有提出異議；2016 年再拿到 GRAS 通知 GRN 000635 的無異議函，允許食品飲料每份添加到 300 毫克。這兩組編號今天晚上拿手機就能在 fda.gov 的名錄裡查到，一分鐘的事。我在這份榜單把成分分成三級：在 FDA 名錄裡查得到編號、在 2025 年新狀態下合法可售、兩者皆無。Tru Niagen、Life Extension 與 Pure Encapsulations 都用同一款授權的 Niagen 原料，所以一起站在最高那一級。

highlights.title: 三分之一的 NMN 對不上標示，所以請認有日期又有批號的檢驗報告
highlights.body: Sandalova 等人 2024 年在 GeroScience 測了 18 款 NMN 補給品，實測含量落在標示值的 0% 到 104.5% 之間，只有 7 款落在正負 10% 以內。這就是 Renue By Science 在我的 NMN 名單裡排第一的理由，瓶底印的批號可以對到官網上有日期的第三方報告，你買到的那一瓶本身就查得到。願意把報告連到批號等級的品牌，才給得起這份信任。

highlights.title: 把每月花費換算到臨床劑量再比，數字會整個重排

highlights.title: 先挑分子，再挑願意公開批次報告的品牌
highlights.body: NR 累積的人體試驗數量最多，包括 Elysium 那篇發表在 npj Aging 的雙盲安慰劑對照研究，一個月內 NAD+ 平均上升 40%，這個深度就是我前四名全給 NR 的原因。NMN 在法規狀態明朗之後，變成達到臨床劑量最省錢的路線，partiQlar 一個月約 32 美元就是最好的例子。路線挑好之後，剩下的注意力全部放在這個品牌有沒有公開到批號等級的檢驗結果。

en.commentary:
Tru Niagen 300mg keeps first at 9.4 and my ranking holds on its second day. Yesterday I argued that the NR versus NMN choice finally comes down to merit. Today I want to show you the study that tells you how small that merit gap really is, and why it makes brand documentation the deciding factor.

In the first head-to-head human trial of three NAD+ precursors, published in Nature Metabolism by Cuenoud and colleagues at Nestle Health Science, NR and NMN each roughly doubled whole-blood NAD+ after 14 days. Nicotinamide raised it only briefly, around four hours after a dose. The mechanism was the surprise: the data suggest gut bacteria convert NR and NMN into nicotinic acid, a potent NAD+ precursor, and both also raised short-chain fatty acids.

My reading is simple. If the two molecules land in the same place, you should choose the bottle whose contents you can verify. That is why Tru Niagen stays first with its public FDA paperwork, why Thorne NiaCel 400 stays second with NSF certification on the finished product, and why Renue By Science holds fifth as my NMN pick, because its batch numbers match dated certificates.

I want to keep expectations honest too. Ubie's 2026 physician roundup describes human NMN trials at 250 to 500 mg daily over eight to twelve weeks, with modest metabolic and vascular signals and good short-term safety, while lifespan claims remain unproven. That is a reasonable basis for a trial of your own and a thin basis for a long subscription.

My advice: pick NR or NMN on price per verified milligram, take it for twelve weeks, and judge it on how you feel and any bloodwork your doctor already runs.

highlights.title: NR and NMN performed alike
highlights.body: A Nature Metabolism head-to-head found both roughly doubled whole-blood NAD+ after 14 days, while nicotinamide gave only a brief rise.

highlights.title: Gut bacteria do the conversion
highlights.body: The trial suggests microbes turn NR and NMN into nicotinic acid, which then raises NAD+ in blood.

highlights.title: Documentation decides the brand
highlights.body: When the molecules match, verifiable paperwork is the tiebreaker, which keeps Tru Niagen first and Thorne second.

highlights.title: Run a twelve-week test
highlights.body: Human trials ran 8 to 12 weeks at 250 to 500 mg. Use that window to judge value before committing long term.

zh-tw.commentary:
Tru Niagen 300mg 繼續第一，9.4 分，榜單上線第二天排名不動。昨天我說 NR 和 NMN 終於可以純比實力，今天我要給你看一份研究，它會告訴你兩者的實力差距有多小，也說明為什麼品牌文件才是決勝點。

雀巢健康科學的 Cuenoud 團隊在 Nature Metabolism 發表了第一個人體直接比較三種 NAD+ 前驅物的試驗。結果 NR 和 NMN 吃 14 天後，全血 NAD+ 都大約翻倍；菸鹼醯胺只在服用後四小時左右短暫拉高。最有意思的是機制：數據顯示腸道細菌會把 NR 和 NMN 轉成菸鹼酸，菸鹼酸本身就是很強的 NAD+ 前驅物，而且兩者都讓短鏈脂肪酸增加。

我的解讀很直白。既然兩種分子效果差不多，你就該挑內容物查得到的那一瓶。這就是 Tru Niagen 靠公開的 FDA 文件穩坐第一、Thorne NiaCel 400 靠成品 NSF 認證拿第二的原因，也是 Renue By Science 以 NMN 首選排第五的理由，它瓶身批號對得上有日期的檢驗證書。

期待值也要講清楚。Ubie 整理的 2026 年醫師觀點提到，人體 NMN 試驗多半是每天 250 到 500 mg、為期八到十二週，看到的是溫和的代謝和血管訊號，短期安全性不錯，延長壽命則還沒有證據。拿來自己試一輪很合理，綁長期訂閱就太早了。

在台灣，這類產品多半靠跨境電商或代購，一個月花費大概落在一千多到一千五台幣。我的建議是：用每毫克的已驗證成本來選 NR 或 NMN，吃滿十二週，再看自己的體感和年度健檢數字決定要不要續。

en.commentary:
Tru Niagen 300mg keeps first at 9.4 and my ranking holds for a third day. Yesterday I walked through the head-to-head precursor trial. Today I want to step back and look at what the expert consensus says you can reasonably expect, because that sets the ceiling for every product on this page.

The clearest summary I know came out of the University of Oslo and Akershus University Hospital, published as an expert review in Nature Aging with more than 25 scientists. They describe NAD+ as central to cellular energy and DNA repair, and note that levels decline with age. They also report that some trials of NR and NMN show improvements in memory, movement and metabolic health. Then comes the part I want every buyer to read: the authors say larger and longer patient studies are needed, along with better data on dose, long-term safety and why people respond so differently.

That last point shapes my ranking. If responses vary widely between people, you need a product whose dose you can trust, so your own experiment means something. Tru Niagen leads because the NR from Niagen Bioscience, formerly ChromaDex, has the deepest human safety file and consistent third-party testing. Thorne NiaCel 400 stays second with the same ingredient at a higher dose. Life Extension's NAD+ Cell Regenerator holds third on quality control and price per milligram.

My practical advice is to run a disciplined trial. Pick one product, take it at the label dose for eight to twelve weeks, and note sleep, energy and exercise recovery before and after. If you want a harder number, some clinics offer NAD+ blood testing. Norway is also running trials of NR and NMN, so better answers are coming, and I will adjust scores as they land.

highlights.title: An expert review sets realistic expectations
highlights.body: More than 25 scientists writing in Nature Aging see promise in NR and NMN, and call for larger, longer trials on dose and long-term safety.

highlights.title: People respond differently
highlights.body: The authors highlight wide variation between individuals, which makes a trustworthy, tested dose the most important buying criterion.

highlights.title: Tru Niagen leads on safety data
highlights.body: Niagen Bioscience's NR has the deepest human safety record in the category, and that keeps it first at 9.4.

highlights.body: Use one product at the label dose for 8 to 12 weeks and track sleep, energy and recovery before and after.

我覺得講得最清楚的，是挪威奧斯陸大學和 Akershus 大學醫院牽頭、超過 25 位科學家在 Nature Aging 發表的專家回顧。他們說 NAD+ 是細胞產能和 DNA 修復的核心分子，而且會隨年齡下降。部分 NR 和 NMN 試驗也看到記憶、行動力和代謝健康的改善。接下來這段我希望每個買家都看：作者明確表示，需要更大、更長期的病人研究，也需要更多劑量、長期安全性，以及個體反應差異的數據。

最後這一點直接影響我的排名。既然每個人反應差很多，你就需要劑量可靠的產品，自己試出來的結果才有參考價值。Tru Niagen 領先，是因為 Niagen Bioscience（前身為 ChromaDex）的 NR 人體安全數據最完整，第三方檢驗也穩定。Thorne NiaCel 400 第二，同樣的成分、劑量更高。Life Extension 的 NAD+ Cell Regenerator 第三，品管扎實，每毫克單價也漂亮。

我的建議是有紀律地自己做實驗。選一款，照標示劑量吃八到十二週，吃之前和之後記錄睡眠、精神和運動後恢復。在台灣，一罐動輒兩三千元起跳，花這個錢就要認真記錄。挪威也正在跑 NR 和 NMN 的臨床試驗，更好的答案會陸續出來，我會跟著調整分數。

en.commentary: Tru Niagen keeps the top spot on regulatory footing alone: it is the branded NR ingredient (Niagen) that has carried FDA GRAS status for years, and that certainty in labeling and manufacturing still separates it from most of the NMN field. But the regulatory gap between NR and NMN narrowed significantly this cycle. The FDA reversed its earlier position and confirmed NMN is lawful for use in dietary supplements, which is genuinely good news for the four NMN products on this list, Renue By Science, partiQlar, Double Wood, and Wonderfeel, and I have nudged their regulatory sub-scores up to reflect that cleaner legal footing. It is not enough to overtake the NR leaders this cycle, since Tru Niagen, Thorne, and Life Extension still hold deeper manufacturing track records and testing documentation, but the direction is clearly toward parity. On the science side, a new human trial directly comparing NAD+ precursors found that both NMN and NR roughly double circulating NAD+ levels after two weeks, while plain niacinamide does not, which backs up why I keep both ingredient families in my top ten, with neither one favored outright. Elysium's Basis holds fourth by combining NR with pterostilbene, which the evidence still supports as a reasonable synergist even though it commands a premium. My baseline advice has not changed: pick NR if you want the deepest safety and manufacturing track record, and NMN is now a legitimately safer bet than it was even a year ago, provided you buy from a brand that publishes batch-level third-party testing.

highlights.body: The FDA has confirmed NMN is lawful in dietary supplements, reversing its earlier stance. I have raised the regulatory sub-scores for Renue By Science, partiQlar, Double Wood, and Wonderfeel to reflect this, though NR still holds a longer compliance track record.

highlights.title: New head-to-head trial data favors both NMN and NR over niacinamide
highlights.body: A direct human comparison found NMN and NR both roughly double circulating NAD+ after two weeks of use, while plain niacinamide did not, which is why both ingredient families sit in my top ten, with neither one dominating.

highlights.title: Tru Niagen's branded ingredient status still matters
highlights.body: Years of GRAS-backed manufacturing and labeling consistency keep Niagen-based Tru Niagen at number one. That track record is not something a regulatory status change alone can match overnight.

highlights.title: Batch-level testing separates the trustworthy NMN brands
highlights.body: With NMN's legal status now cleaner, the real differentiator shifts to whether a brand publishes third-party batch testing. That is where I still favor established players over newer NMN entrants.

不過這次 NR 跟 NMN 之間的法規落差明顯縮小了。FDA 這次翻轉之前的立場,確認 NMN 可以合法用在膳食補充品裡,這對榜上四款 NMN 產品(Renue By Science、partiQlar、Double Wood、Wonderfeel)是真的利多,我也把它們的法規分數稍微往上調了一點。

en.commentary: Tru Niagen holds the top spot again, and I want to frame this week's ranking around something bigger than any single ingredient debate. The supplement industry grew 5.5% in 2025 to $72.9 billion, and longevity products like NAD boosters are one of the categories pulling in buyers who were not traditional supplement shoppers a few years ago, people coming from biohacking forums and longevity podcasts more than a vitamin aisle. That audience tends to research harder before buying, which is exactly why Tru Niagen's 9.8 regulatory score still matters so much, Niagen has carried FDA GRAS status for years and that paper trail gives newer buyers real confidence when they are choosing between a dozen unfamiliar brand names. Thorne's NiaCel 400 holds second with a 9.6 testing score, the highest in the category, batch-level certificates of analysis that satisfy the more skeptical, research-first buyer this category increasingly attracts. Life Extension's NAD+ Cell Regenerator stays third on a 9.6 regulatory score of its own and a 9.4 value score that keeps monthly cost reasonable at a clinically relevant dose. Elysium's Basis holds fourth with the strongest testing and regulatory combination outside the top three, a 9.5 testing score backed by its own published research on the Basis formula, on top of the underlying NR ingredient studies. Renue By Science's Lipo NMN rounds out my top five with a 9.4 testing score, liposomal delivery aims at the absorption question that still separates NMN from the more established NR side of this category. My core advice stays put, if you want the calmest regulatory footing, buy NR, if you want NMN specifically, buy from a brand that publishes its own batch testing, a step beyond a certificate from the raw ingredient supplier alone.

en.commentary: Tru Niagen keeps the top spot because it remains the most clinically validated NAD boosting supplement on the market, built on nicotinamide riboside with more published human trials behind it than any other ingredient in this category. That evidence base, combined with third party testing and a pharmaceutical grade manufacturing standard, is exactly what a longevity supplement buyer should prioritize. Thorne's NiaCel 400 holds second on the strength of Thorne's broader reputation for NSF Certified for Sport manufacturing and consistent, independently verified potency testing, a standard that matters enormously in a supplement category where third party verification is not yet universal. Life Extension's NAD Cell Regenerator earns third by combining NR with supporting cofactors like resveratrol, giving it a broader formulation than single ingredient competitors. Elysium's Basis continues to rank well for its own published peer reviewed research on its specific NR and pterostilbene combination, a rare thing in a supplement category full of unverified claims. The NMN focused entries, Renue By Science, PartiQlar, Double Wood and Wonderfeel, all rank in the middle of the pack. NMN research is promising and its regulatory status as a lawful dietary supplement is settled, but the NR based leaders at the top of this list have a deeper track record of third party verified potency and published human outcomes, which is exactly what this ranking rewards. Pure Encapsulations and Jinfiniti round out the list with clean, trustworthy formulations that are earlier in building the same depth of published evidence as the category leaders. I am keeping every rank unchanged this cycle because nothing in current research shifts the fundamental evidence gap between these tiers.

en.commentary:
Tru Niagen 300mg stays on top, and the reason is worth restating with the regulatory backdrop in view. FDA confirmed in letters dated September 29, 2025 that NMN counts as a lawful dietary supplement ingredient, ending a long dispute that the Natural Products Association took to court. That decision opened the door for more NMN products, and Renue By Science Lipo NMN on this list sits in that camp. I welcome the competition, and I still put nicotinamide riboside first because the human trial record behind it is the deepest in the category.

When I compare NAD products, I read three things on the label. First is the exact ingredient and the milligrams per serving, since NR, NMN and niacin-based formulas behave differently. Second is third party testing, because NAD precursors are pricey and the supplement aisle has plenty of underdosed powders. Third is the serving schedule. Thorne NiaCel 400 earns second place because it publishes a clean dose and a simple daily routine, and Life Extension NAD+ Cell Regenerator is a strong value pick from a brand that has a long testing history.

Elysium Basis sits fourth and remains a solid combination of nicotinamide riboside and pterostilbene for people who want that second ingredient.

Nothing published this week changes my scoring, so the order stays. My practical advice is to pick one product, take it consistently for a couple of months, and judge it by how you feel and what your doctor sees in bloodwork, then adjust from there.

highlights.body: Nicotinamide riboside has the largest published human trial record among NAD precursors, which anchors my first place.

highlights.body: The September 29, 2025 letters confirmed NMN as lawful in supplements, so more NMN options are arriving.
